
  Your setup

  Your home
  · Use this computer away from home: Not yet — set up Home Assistant Link to connect this computer away from home.
    ha-nova cloud add

  AI apps on this computer
  ✓ Claude Code: HA NOVA is set up in this AI app.
  · Codex: Not yet — add HA NOVA to this AI app.
    ha-nova setup codex
  · OpenCode: Not yet — add HA NOVA to this AI app.
    ha-nova setup opencode
  · Google Antigravity: Not yet — add HA NOVA to this AI app.
    ha-nova setup antigravity
  · Hermes Agent: Not yet — add HA NOVA to this AI app.
    ha-nova setup hermes
  · Other AI apps: Any app that supports MCP can use HA NOVA: add this to its MCP settings.
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "ha-nova": {
      "command": "<home>/.local/bin/ha-nova",
      "args": [
        "mcp"
      ]
    }
  }
}
